craft_notes: Sthāyin: cakrodaya unit 60. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Is divided division and again indeed three-by-three; in first-rising but having rested by second should rise when.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vibhajyate vibhāgaśca punareva triśastriśaḥ pūrvodaye tu viśramya dvitīyenollasedyadā
